test_title: PYST 7: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven persons A, B, C, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row facing north. Only three persons are sitting between V and T. U is sitting to the immediate left of T. No one is sitting to the right of C. Only two persons are sitting between C and U. W is sitting to the immediate right of A. How many persons are sitting between B and W?
solution:
GIven :Seven persons A, B, C, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row facing north.

 
• Only three persons are sitting between V and T.
 
• U is sitting to the immediate left of T.
 
• No one is sitting to the right of C.
 
• Only two persons are sitting between C and U.
 
• W is sitting to the immediate right of A

The final arrangement is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47ce3ec6ae016b559ae13c8a439d7d837cf6307c0f5e4a73802e94299867fb4a.png] ​

Two persons are sitting between B and W.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
